question: 'Getting A Grip: On My Body, My Mind, My Self' is an autobiography by who among the following tennis icons?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Monica Seles**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Monica Seles, a former world No. 1 tennis player, is the author of the autobiography "Getting A Grip: On My Body, My Mind, My Self."
 
• The autobiography was published in April 2009.
 
• In the book, Seles discusses her struggles with binge eating and the pressures of being a professional athlete.
 
• She also opens up about the infamous on-court stabbing incident in 1993 and its impact on her life and career.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Monica Seles**:

 
 
• Born on December 2, 1973, in Novi Sad, Yugoslavia (now Serbia).
 
• She became the youngest-ever French Open champion at 16 in 1990.
 
• Seles won a total of 9 Grand Slam singles titles during her career.
 
• In 1994, she became a U.S. citizen.
 
 
 
• **1993 Stabbing Incident**:
 
 
• On April 30, 1993, Seles was stabbed by a deranged fan of Steffi Graf during a match in Hamburg, Germany.
 
• The incident led to a prolonged hiatus from professional tennis, with Seles returning to the sport in 1995.
 
 
 
• **Binge Eating Disorder**:
 
 
• Binge eating disorder is characterized by recurrent episodes of eating large quantities of food, often quickly and to the point of discomfort.
 
• Seles discusses her battle with this disorder in her autobiography and its impact on her professional life.
 
 
 
• **Autobiographies by Athletes**:
 
 
• Autobiographies provide a personal account of an athlete's career, struggles, and achievements.
 
• They often include behind-the-scenes stories and personal reflections that are not widely known to the public.
